decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's care series builds on the firm's cosmetic formulation know-how but opens a new ingredient concept and target group, so its fit with existing knowledge is only partial, and with no website evidence after 2019 the firm has little basis to interpret results, leaving a moderate risk of being dropped.

The cleansing foam extends the established Sandorini (sea buckthorn) line and draws directly on the firm's existing formulation and ingredient knowledge, so the firm can learn from its results and improve it within a familiar series, which makes keeping it likely.
